title: KEEP and FREE come off the bar, and a switch for trees falling over
question: Is KEEP where you would look for it -- on the page you already opened on that plant -- and is PLACE in the rack the right home for putting one back?
context_md:
Three of your four reports, all in the interface.

**KEEP and FREE are gone from the tool row**, which is down from eight buttons to six. Keeping is now a button in the top-right of the cell page, so you point at a plant, read it, and jar it from the page that is already open on it -- no second click to aim a tool. Putting one back is `PLACE` in the rack, which closes the rack and hands the next click in the box to the specimen; the jar chip on the bar lights up while that is armed so you can see the mode you are in. `M` and `,` still work.

**COLLAPSE UNDER LOAD, at the top of the PLANT page**, is the switch you asked for. Off holds every plant in the box together however far it leans -- both ways a plant can break under weight, since you cannot tell them apart from outside. Cutting still works either way: what you sever still falls. It survives REBUILD.

**And the species chip no longer un-picks PLANT.** That was the tool button's own put-it-away toggle being reached by the chip beside it.

The third tile is a real screen with the row on it; ignore the plant numbers, they are whatever the test bed grew.
